english: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
text: 这里 go on a diet 是“开始节食”，不是“继续减肥”，中文容易把 go on 理解成“继续”。想表达“正在节食”常用 be on a diet，想表达“开始节食”才用 go on a diet，别只看单个短语直译。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
